title: திருக்குறள் - அதிகாரம் 1 - கடவுள் வாழ்த்து!

metadata.tags: A fusion of Indian Carnatic classical music and contemporary cinematic pop. The track features a prominent, resonant acoustic guitar playing rhythmic arpeggios and percussive slaps, accompanied by a lush string section providing cinematic swells. The lead male vocal is a rich, expressive tenor utilizing traditional Indian gamakas (melodic oscillations) and intricate melismatic phrasing. The song is set in a moderate tempo with a 4/4 time signature, likely in a major key with modal influences characteristic of South Indian ragas. Production is clean and spacious, with a light reverb on the vocals and a crisp, forward-mixed acoustic guitar. The structure follows a traditional verse-chorus format, building in intensity with the addition of orchestral layers and subtle ambient textures.
